title: WCL Mining Sirdar Mock Test 16
subtitle: Western Coalfields Limited — Mining Sirdar Recruitment
instructions: Select the best answer for each question

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'objective' of an accident report is to
options: Estimating the cost of the shift that was lost
Blaming a particular person for the accident that occurred
Present facts and findings to prevent recurrence
Recording the tonnage of the coal that was won
questions.solution: Present facts and findings to prevent recurrence.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The depth of a shaft is measured from
options: Any point
The bank to the sump
The collar to the bottom
The surface only
questions.solution: From the collar to the bottom of the shaft.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The detonation velocity of emulsion explosives is typically
questions.solution: Emulsion explosives have detonation velocity of 4000-5000 m/s, suitable for coal mining.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'fire alarm' in a mine must be
options: These are fitted only in the mine office for record purposes
These are connected to the canteen bell of the mining area
These are audible only at the pit bottom of the open pit workings
Clearly audible throughout the mine and tested regularly
questions.solution: Clearly audible and tested regularly.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: An 'emergency fire response plan' must be
options: These are stored in the manager's office drawer of the mine
Documented, communicated, and drilled regularly
These are prepared only after a fire has taken place
These are kept confidential and are not shown
questions.solution: Documented, communicated, and drilled regularly.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The earliest stage of coal formation is
options: Peat
Lignite
Anthracite
Bituminous
questions.solution: Peat is the earliest stage of coal formation.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The immediate cause of an accident is usually
options: It is a decision taken by the management
Unsafe act or unsafe condition
It is a natural disaster of any kind
It is the government policy of the
questions.solution: Unsafe act or unsafe condition is the immediate cause.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The advantage of stowing over caving is
options: There is no advantage at all in this method of working the seam
Better ground control and reduced surface subsidence
It requires no heavy machinery at all to be used in the mine
It is quicker than the method of caving the roof of the mine
questions.solution: Better ground control and reduced subsidence.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The maximum gradient for a track-based man riding system is
options: 1 in 3
1 in 5
1 in 10
1 in 2
questions.solution: 1 in 5 for track-based systems.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'borehole survey' is important to determine
options: Mapping the underground water flows beneath the mine workings
The actual path and position of boreholes underground
Determining the grade of the coal that is being mined here
Testing the winding ropes of the mine hoist at the pit bottom
questions.solution: Actual path and position of boreholes underground.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Man riding on a conveyor belt is
options: Allowed with proper
Never permitted
Only at night time
Always permitted
questions.solution: Man riding on a conveyor belt is never permitted.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The bench height in opencast coal mines depends on
options: A fixed height is prescribed for all the mines of the country
The colour of the overburden material of the open cast mine
The name of the mine manager of that particular mining area
Equipment reach, seam thickness, and geological conditions
questions.solution: Bench height depends on equipment, seam thickness, and geology.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The danger of inundation arises when
options: It is raining heavily in the mining area at that time
The mine workings are kept completely dry at all times here
Working approaches water-logged areas or old workings
The ventilation fan of the mine is running at that time here
questions.solution: Working approaches water-logged areas or old workings.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'borehole' in coal exploration is drilled to
options: To extract the coal from the seam that is being worked here
To install a permanent ventilation shaft for the mine workings
To dredge the overburden that lies in the open cast pit
Collect geological information about coal deposits
questions.solution: Boreholes collect geological information about deposits.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'drilling report' should contain
options: The names of the visitors who are permitted to enter the mine
The canteen menu that is served to the mine workers each day
The leave roster that is prepared for the mine workers of the mine
Location, depth, diameter, strata encountered, and any problems
questions.solution: Location, depth, diameter, strata, and problems.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'ventilation monitoring' frequency should be
options: It is carried out during the annual audit of the mine records
Continuous for critical areas, regular for others
It is carried out after a major fire has taken place in the mine
It is carried out after every ten years of operation of the mine
questions.solution: Monitoring should be continuous for critical areas.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The priming of explosive cartridges in underground coal mines is done by
options: The Mine Manager
The Sirdar
A certified Shot Firer
Any worker
questions.solution: Only certified Shot Firers can prime explosive cartridges.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The interval between two consecutive shifts in a mine must be at least
options: 12 hours
6 hours
8 hours
4 hours
questions.solution: At least 8 hours.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'drift drainage' system must handle
options: Only the water from the office
Only the rain water at the portal
No drainage of the mine water is needed
Groundwater and drilling water
questions.solution: Drift drainage handles both groundwater and drilling water.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A switchboard in a mine must be
options: Any board of the mine may be used for this purpose in the workings
It is painted in bright colours so that it is clearly visible to the mine workers
It is fixed inside the mine sump of the underground workings of the mine area
Clearly labeled, protected from damage, and accessible only to authorized persons
questions.solution: Clearly labeled, protected, and accessible to authorized persons.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The sirdar must ensure proper disposal of
options: Only the office papers of the mine are stored
The slurry water from the mine sump is stored
All waste materials and used cartridges
The overburden from the quarry
questions.solution: All waste materials and used cartridges must be properly disposed.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A person winding in a shaft must not exceed the
options: There is any limit on the number of persons allowed in it
The quantity of the coal that is carried in the mine tub
The speed limit of the mine haulage is the only consideration
Maximum number of persons or load as specified
questions.solution: Maximum persons or load as specified.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'explosive storage magazine' must be located at
options: They are used for the drilling of the blast holes in the mine round
A safe distance from mines, dwellings, and other structures
They are kept underground in the mine workings at the pit bottom of the mine
They may be used at any place in the mine where the ground is stable
questions.solution: Safe distance from mines, dwellings, and structures.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'ribs' in bord and pillar mining are
options: The cross-cuts between two roadways
The sides of pillars that support the roof
The props erected under the roof
The roadways through the pillar line
questions.solution: Sides of pillars supporting the roof.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'sprinkler system' in a mine is used to
options: To decorate the underground roadways of the mine workings here
To cool the water that is held in the sump of the mine
To damp the coal dust that lies on the floor of the roadways
Automatically suppress fire in the protected area
questions.solution: Automatically suppresses fire in protected area.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Highwall mining extracts minerals from
options: Ramp face
Pit floor
Highwall
Mine dump
questions.solution: Highwall mining extracts directly from highwall face.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'flyrock' in opencast blasting can be controlled by
options: Increasing the charge weight of the explosive
Proper burden, stemming, and spacing
Using more detonators in the blasting round
Reducing the safety distance from the persons
questions.solution: Proper blast design minimizes flyrock risk.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'underground refuge station' must be stocked with
options: A box of the matches and the candles that are used by the men
A spade and a shovel that is used by the working person at the face
Water, food, first aid, communication device, and oxygen supply
A bundle of the timber props that are kept ready at the mine face
questions.solution: Water, food, first aid, communication, and oxygen supply.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'main fan' in mine ventilation provides
options: Primary air movement through the mine
Control humidity in underground workings
An emergency lighting supply
There is no air movement in the mine workings
questions.solution: Main fans provide primary air movement through the mine.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: An 'underground mine fire' is more dangerous than a surface fire because of
options: It is easier for the persons to reach the face of the mine working
Confined space, presence of methane, and limited escape routes
There is more oxygen available for the persons who are working in the mine
There is no difference at all in these two sets of conditions of the mine
questions.solution: Confined space, methane, and limited escape routes.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under CMR 2017, the 'competent person' for examination of safety lamps must be
options: A person authorized by the manager
Any person holding a first aid certificate
It may be any person of the whole mine
A person appointed by the contractor
questions.solution: A person authorized by the manager.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'tacheometer' in surveying is used for
options: Measuring distances using stadia hairs
It is used for measuring the percentage
Reduction of levels below the seam
Setting out the shot hole pattern
questions.solution: Measuring distances using stadia hairs.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The main causes of accidents in coal mines include
options: Roof fall, gas ignition, machinery, transportation, and drowning
Earthquake tremors and the cyclonic winds that affect the mine surface
The seasonal monsoon flooding of the mine workings during the rains
A shortage of the underground illumination of the mine roadways at the face
questions.solution: Multiple causes including roof fall, gas, machinery, transportation, and drowning.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: As per MVTR 1966, refresher vocational training must be given to persons employed in mines at least once in:
options: 5 years
2 years
1 year
10 years
questions.solution: MVTR 1966, Rule 8: refresher training at least once in every 5 years.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'bolt diameter' in coal mines is typically
options: 30 mm
40 mm
6 mm
questions.solution: Typical bolt diameters are 16-22 mm for coal mine roof support.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'error of closure' in a traverse must be checked against
options: The instrument constant of the theodolite
The least count of the total station
The permissible error limits as prescribed
It is zero at all times in the mine survey work
questions.solution: Permissible error limits as prescribed.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'safety catch' on a cage must be able to
options: Slow the cage during the inspection
Arrest the cage if the rope breaks
Ventilate the cage at each level
Hold the cage at the pit bottom
questions.solution: Arrest the cage if the rope breaks.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'drift closure' after completion may require
options: It is done by painting the portal of the mine surface
There is no closure of the mine area at all
Sealing, support, or abandonment procedures
It is done by leaving the machinery inside the mine
questions.solution: Drift closure may require sealing, support, or abandonment.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'drill bit' selection for drifting depends on
options: Rock hardness, abrasiveness, and drilling method
A fixed type of the drill bit is used for the drilling of holes
The colour of the rock that is being drilled by the machine
The number of the workers employed in the mine drilling gang
questions.solution: Drill bit selection depends on rock properties and method.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'box cut' in opencast mining refers to
options: The type of the explosive that is used in the
Initial cut to establish working face
The storage container of the explosives of the
The square excavation of the coal in the mine
questions.solution: Box cut is the initial excavation to establish working face.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'pillar recovery' in depillaring involves
options: Systematic extraction of coal from pillars
Increasing the size of the mine coal pillars
Building the mine coal pillars in the underground
Extraction of the coal from the surface
questions.solution: Pillar recovery systematically extracts coal from pillars.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'stowing dam' in mines is built to
options: Retain stowing material in the goaf area
To provide the support of the mine roof and the mine
To provide the direct ventilation
To store the water of the mine in the sump
questions.solution: Stowing dams retain material in the goaf.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'fire incident report' must include
options: The wages that are paid to the mine workers for the work done by them
The attendance of the mine shift of the workers in the mine that day
The leave roster that is maintained for the mine workers of that mine shift
Location, time, cause, extent of damage, and actions taken
questions.solution: Location, time, cause, extent of damage, and actions taken.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'through borehole' in inundation prevention must be drilled
options: From the working face towards the suspected water source
From the surface office of the mine downwards towards the workings
Through the worked out goaf of the mine area in the underground workings
It is done underground in the mine area only in the mine workings
questions.solution: From the working face towards the suspected water source.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'emergency stop' buttons on equipment must be
options: Accessible from both inside and outside cab
It is fitted only on the roof of the mine machine
On the steering wheel of the cab
It is inside the cab of the machine only
questions.solution: Emergency stops must be accessible from inside and outside.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'development headings' in bord and pillar are driven to
options: Forming the surface dumps of the open cast mine workings
Creating the ventilation columns in the underground mine
Storing the coal of the mine in the mine stockpile area
Create access to the coal panel and form pillars
questions.solution: Create access and form pillars.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Coal dust explosion is more severe when
options: There is good ventilation
The mine is wet in that area here
Methane gas is also present
The mine is newly opened in the area
questions.solution: More severe when methane gas is also present.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A SDL is used in
options: Underground coal mines for loading coal
The open cast mines used for drilling the holes
The shaft sinking done for the hoisting of coal
Surface workshops for maintenance
questions.solution: Used in underground coal mines for loading coal.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'water drainage' during drifting is important because
options: The pumping capacity of the mine pumps is unlimited here
Water improves the road surface of the mine workings here
It is not true for the mine workings at all here indeed
Water can weaken the rock and make conditions unsafe
questions.solution: Water can weaken rock and make conditions unsafe.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: An earth leakage relay is used to
options: It is the earth fault protection of the mine circuit only
It is the distance protection of the mine circuit only
Detect and disconnect supply in case of earth leakage fault
It is the overcurrent protection of the mine circuit only
questions.solution: Detects and disconnects supply in case of earth leakage.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'scaling' after blasting in a drift is done to
options: Charge the hole again for a second blast
To install the roof bolts of the mine before scaling the roof
To increase the rate of the advance of the mine drift
Remove loose and unstable rock from the roof and sides
questions.solution: Removes loose and unstable rock.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'ventilation power' required depends on
options: Provide fresh air to working faces
To regulate the air temperature of the mine workings only
A fixed power rating is prescribed for every mine
Air quantity, resistance, and fan efficiency
questions.solution: Ventilation power depends on quantity, resistance, efficiency.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'smoke detection system' in a mine must be
options: These are installed only in the mine lamp room of that mine
These are optional in all the mines of that mining area
These are fitted only at the portal of that particular mine
Installed in all important locations and regularly tested
questions.solution: Installed in important locations and regularly tested.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A man riding system on a slope must have
options: An anti-rollback device
A spare battery
A canvas roof only
A fog lamp
questions.solution: An anti-rollback device.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'rescue team medical fitness' must be checked
options: When the person joins
When the member is ill
It is never ever done
At least annually
questions.solution: Medical fitness must be checked at least annually.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'overspeed governor' on a winding engine must
options: Automatically apply brakes if speed exceeds safe limits
To increase the winding speed of the mine hoist at the shaft
It is a device that is used to cut the coal of the mine seam
To sound an alarm after the overwind of the mine cage occurs
questions.solution: Automatically applies brakes if speed exceeds limits.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'refuge chamber' ventilation must provide
options: To regulate the air temperature of the mine workings only
It is a single candle that is lit in the mine workings
An auxiliary fan that is placed at the entrance of the mine
Fresh air supply independent of mine ventilation
questions.solution: Refuge chambers need independent fresh air supply.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under the Mines Vocational Training Rules 1966, a person before being employed in a mine for the first time must undergo:
options: One month of refresher training for the workers of that mine
A reading of the safety rules to the workers of that mine
Initial vocational training in the prescribed subjects
A practical test that is held on the surface of the mine area
questions.solution: MVTR 1966, Rule 6: every person is given initial vocational training before first employment.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The Mines Vocational Training Rules, 1966 prescribe
options: The colours that are used for the buildings of the mine offices
The dress code that is prescribed for the mine officials of the mine
Training requirements for different categories of mine workers
The design that is given to the logo of that particular mine
questions.solution: Training requirements for different categories of mine workers.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'hierarchy of controls' for accident prevention includes
options: The removal of the ventilation officer of that particular mine area
The replacement of the mine surveyor of that particular mine area
Elimination, substitution, engineering controls, administrative controls, and PPE
The reduction of the length of the mine shift at the mine workings
questions.solution: Elimination, substitution, engineering controls, administrative controls, and PPE.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'audience' of a report determines
options: The number of the pages of the report prepared for the mine
The length of the appendices of the report of that mine record
The colour of the cover that is used for the mine report record
The level of detail, language, and format to be used
questions.solution: The level of detail, language, and format.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'water dam closure' in emergencies is done by
options: Painting of the surface of the stowing dam of the mine area
No closure of the water flow is needed for the mine dam
Closing valves and openings to block water flow
Increasing the speed of the mine stowing water pump here
questions.solution: Emergency closure involves blocking water flow through valves.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The maximum speed for an inclined man riding system is
options: 2 m/s
3 m/s
5 m/s
1 m/s
questions.solution: Maximum speed is 3 m/s for inclined systems.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'ventilation pressure' is measured using
options: A tachometer for the mine fan
A watt meter for the mine circuit
A hydrometer for the mine water
A manometer or pressure gauge
questions.solution: A manometer or pressure gauge.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'old workings mapping' is important to
options: It is only a formality of the mine management of the area
Fix the output target of the district
Identify areas of potential water accumulation
To determine the colour of the rock strata of the mine area
questions.solution: Mapping old workings identifies potential water accumulation areas.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'hydraulic prop' in underground mines provides
options: Yielding support with constant load capacity
It is a wooden pillar that is used in the mine workings
It is a timber chock that is used in the mine workings
It is a fixed timber support used in the mine workings
questions.solution: Hydraulic props provide yielding support with constant load.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The sirdar is responsible for the supervision of
options: The blasting gang in the district
The surface workers on the dumps
All persons under his charge in the shift
The newly inducted trainees of the mine in that shift
questions.solution: The sirdar is responsible for all persons under his charge during the shift.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The drill machine used in underground mines for face drilling is
options: Only a hand held hammer is used for it
A jackhammer alone is used for this work
Pneumatic or hydraulic drill machine
Only a compressor is used for this work
questions.solution: Pneumatic or hydraulic drill machines are used.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The man riding system must be capable of operating during
options: Emergency conditions including power failure
The day shift hours alone of the mine shift of that area
Times when the manager is present
Dry weather conditions prevail in the mining area then
questions.solution: Must operate during emergency conditions including power failure.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A winding engine must have a device to
options: A spare winding rope of the hoist
An auxiliary fan of the mine is used
No device at all is used for it
Prevent overwinding the cage
questions.solution: Prevent overwinding.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: 'Competent person' under the Mines Act 1952 means a person:
options: He is appointed by the Inspector of the mines of that particular mining area
He is having 10 years of experience in the mine workings of that area
Appointed by the owner, agent or manager and possessing the prescribed qualifications
He is holding any degree of any university recognised by that country
questions.solution: Mines Act 1952, s.2(1)(c): a competent person is one appointed by the owner, agent or manager with the prescribed qualifications for the purpose.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A person re-employed after an absence exceeding one year from mining work must undergo refresher training within:
options: 1 week
6 months
1 month of employment
3 months of employment
questions.solution: MVTR 1966, Rule 10: refresher training within 1 month of re-employment after absence over 1 year.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A winding engine must have at least
options: Two independent braking systems
Three braking systems in the mine hoist
No brakes at all in the mine hoist here
Only one braking system in the mine hoist
questions.solution: Two independent braking systems are required.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A first-aid room is required at a mine where the number of persons employed exceeds:
questions.solution: Mines Act 1952, s.21: a first-aid room is required where more than 150 persons are employed.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Methane gas in mines is also known as
options: Black damp
Firedamp
Carbon dioxide
White damp
questions.solution: Methane gas is also known as firedamp.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The sirdar's shift handover must include
options: The number of the mine tubs that have been hauled during the mine shift
Safety conditions, incomplete work, and outstanding issues
The menu of the mine canteen that is served to the mine workers of that mine
The names of the surface staff of the mine who report to the mine manager
questions.solution: Handover must cover safety, incomplete work, and outstanding issues.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The safety committee must include
options: Only the representatives of the owner
Equal representation from management and workers
Only the elected worker representatives
Only the mine manager and his nominees
questions.solution: Equal representation from management and workers.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'danger lamp' or 'safety lamp' regulations are specified in
options: CMR 2017 Regulation 122
Mines Act 1952 Section 18
CMR 2017 Regulation 120
Mines Rules 1955 Rule 45
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Regulation 120.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'drift' theory of coal formation suggests
options: Coal formed from marine organisms
Coal formed from volcanic activity
Coal formed from underwater plants
Coal formed from transported plant material
questions.solution: Drift theory suggests coal formed from transported plant material.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'winding engine house' must be
options: It is made of timber only in the underground mine workings
It is located underground near the shaft of that particular mine area
It may be any building of the mine used for this purpose
Fireproof, well-ventilated, and properly illuminated
questions.solution: Fireproof, well-ventilated, and properly illuminated.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'bench height' in opencast mining depends on
options: The type of equipment, geological conditions, and seam thickness
The colour of the coal that is produced by that particular mine of the country
The number of the workers who are employed in that particular mine of the country
The type of the winding rope that is used at the shaft of that particular mine area
questions.solution: Equipment type, geological conditions, and seam thickness.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: India won its first Cricket World Cup in
questions.solution: India won the Cricket World Cup in 1983.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'mine closure bond' is deposited to ensure
options: Funds for reclamation after mine closure
A bonus that is paid to the management of the mine
Money spent on the annual picnic of the workers
A loan taken for the purchase of new mine dumpers
questions.solution: Funds for reclamation after closure.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: 30% of x is 75. x=?

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The ratio of 45 minutes to 1.5 hours is

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'environmental clearance' for mining projects is required under
options: Environment Protection Act 1986
The Mines Act 1952 alone
The Forest Conservation Act 1980
It is the Contract Act of 1872 here
questions.solution: Required under Environment Protection Act 1986.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'domestic coal allocation' policy was replaced by
options: The Railway freight allotment
FSA and e-auction systems
The State government quota system
The DG of Supplies allotment
questions.solution: Replaced by FSA and e-auction systems.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The Mine Safety Commissioner in India is appointed by
options: District Collector
Company Management
State Government
Central Government
questions.solution: The Mine Safety Commissioner is appointed by the Central Government.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: India became independent on
options: 26th January 1950
15th August 1945
15th August 1947
15th August 1950
questions.solution: India became independent on 15th August 1947.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'coal preparation plant' is used to
options: Clean, grade, and prepare coal for market
Removal of overburden from the pit
It is the benching of the highwall in the open pit
It is the dredging of the district sump of the mine
questions.solution: Cleans, grades, and prepares coal for market.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The capital of Odisha is
options: Kolkata
Bhubaneswar
Patna
Ranchi
questions.solution: Bhubaneswar is the capital of Odisha.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: If 'coal' is to 'mine' as 'fish' is to ?
options: Pond
Ocean
Catch
Water
questions.solution: Coal is extracted from mine, fish is caught from pond.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'coal washeries' are operated by
options: CIL subsidiaries and some private operators
State electricity boards exclusively
Railways on a build operate basis
Foreign contractors on a build transfer basis
questions.solution: CIL subsidiaries and some private operators.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'National Coal Index' was launched to
options: To promote the export of the washed coal produced by that mine
To fix the royalty that is paid on the coal of each mine of that country
To allocate the coal of that mine to the power sector of the country
Track coal price movements for auction and policy purposes
questions.solution: Track coal price movements.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'CMPDI' (Central Mine Planning and Design Institute) is a subsidiary of
options: Government of India
NTPC
Coal India Limited
SAIL
questions.solution: CMPDI is a CIL subsidiary for mine planning and design.
